basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.old: case when regexp_matches(trim(both '"' from list_extract(regexp_extract_all(record, '(^|,)("(?:[^"]|"")*"|\[[^\]]*\]|[^,]*)', 2), 15)), '^https?://') then regexp_extract(trim(both '"' from list_extract(regexp_extract_all(record, '(^|,)("(?:[^"]|"")*"|\[[^\]]*\]|[^,]*)', 2), 15)), '^(https?://[^/?#]+)', 1) || coalesce(regexp_extract(trim(both '"' from list_extract(regexp_extract_all(record, '(^|,)("(?:[^"]|"")*"|\[[^\]]*\]|[^,]*)', 2), 15)), '^[^?#]*?(/[^?#]*)', 1), '') else null end as base_url
